title: ChatGPT: Jack of all trades, master of none
reasoning: The paper benchmarks ChatGPT and GPT-4 on several tasks related to social and ethical norms, such as offensiveness, aggression, and 'unhealthy' conversation detection. Furthermore, it includes a qualitative analysis section specifically evaluating the model's 'sense of common human morality' and its tendency to provide 'moralizing' responses.
